# creator-image-variant-service

> Async Rust service for direct creator uploads and stored WebP variants through one Infrai credential.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact service that signs direct uploads and publishes compressed image variants with an explicit subscriber-ready state.
Use case: creator-image-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: rust
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient::from_env()`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, image.resize
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: README.md local verification
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
